contracts.order: Actual Alchemist -> one Minum Apa? spin -> consume that one potion/apply declared effects -> one actual result reaction -> Backstory. No count or category wheel.
contracts.probability: Working twenty-slot equal default: 5% each, groups 6:4:4:4:2. User requested added slots, not an explicit new probability ratio. Earlier sixteen-slot snapshots retain their original odds.
contracts.stat: Numeric recipes retain -1/0/+1/+2 totals. Two superpower recipes instead grant one linked fixed power, no numeric stat bonus. Freeze exact recipe and apply once per consumed source/ordinal.
contracts.neutral: Ordinary drinks yield zero stat effect, still count as consumed potion result/reaction; no reroll or implied healing/caffeine bonus.
contracts.repetition: Exactly one consumed dose per Alchemist event invocation. No second potion, replacement sequence or uniqueness reroll. Replaying that invocation preserves its result without another consumption or reward.
contracts.ownership: Ordinary consumable recipes apply only declared modifiers. Each actual superpower dose grants its one linked owned power under normal shared mastery and main None retention; no permanent weapon/race/franchise dispatch.
contracts.ledger: Freeze count=1, catalog version, pool and exact recipe before the draw. Dose ordinal 1 has one actual source/ledger key; replay never applies its signed stat modifier or power grant twice.
contracts.reaction: One short actual result/effect reaction per consumed potion. Jamu labels/minuman names are captions; no joke explanation or new funny-result mechanics tag.
contracts.naming: Buff names are real jamu; five exact jamu product names from the dated BPOM finding and one Ciu Oplosan misuse variant are debuffs. Fantasy elixirs follow the user classic-legend direction, not Frieren/Sabatiel. Names/captions/source reports create no new funny tags or extra reward.
contracts.power: El Dorado -> Gold Touch; Philosopher Stone -> Molecular Manipulation. The selected elixir grants one fixed power once, no selector/mastery respin/Enchant. This event has no repeated-dose stacking.

powers.label: Gold Touch (Sentuhan Emas)
powers.scope: Mengubah materi atau target yang disentuh menjadi emas. Batas sasaran, biaya, durasi, resistensi dan kendali mengikuti profil serta mastery.
powers.contentStatus: User-confirmed Gold Touch/classic-legend direction; bounded wording editable.
powers.mechanicalBalance: No automatic victory/stat/weapon/race grant or Midas food curse.
powers.powerTierReason: Transmutasi emas melalui sentuhan; hasil spesifik lebih sempit daripada manipulasi materi umum.

powers.label: Molecular Manipulation (Manipulasi Molekul)
powers.scope: Menyusun ulang struktur dan komposisi materi pada tingkat molekuler untuk mengubah bahan atau membentuk benda; batas materi, biaya, jangkauan dan resistensi mengikuti profil/mastery.
powers.contentStatus: User permits Creation or Molecular Manipulation; this draft chooses one Molecular Manipulation grant, without a selector.
powers.mechanicalBalance: Creation through reshaping matter is the chosen expression; no automatic creation from nothing/life/souls, immortality or Sabatiel LP/card mechanics.
powers.powerTierReason: Menyusun ulang struktur dan komposisi materi umum pada tingkat molekuler.
